name: Mahime Bloody Mary -Shin'en no Maou to Naraku no Himegimi-
original_name: 魔姫ブラッディマリー -深淵の魔王と奈落の姫君-
source:
You are the king of evils who trains and enslaves the human princess Mary to make her one of your kind and your wife.
You have to defend your base against the humans who come to save Mary.
Control the monsters like goblins to fight against the enemy!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE065498.html]DLSite English[/url]]
